bio: 1880 census, Plymouth Township, 11 Jun 1880: Edward F. Jones, 40, miner, born Wales of Welsh parents, with wife Margret and children Ann C. 15, Rose 13, Mary 10 (all born England) and William J. (born Sept 1879, Pennsylvania) ([R4-S1]). The English births show he worked in England (probably a mining district) from at least 1865 to about 1870 before emigrating. His son Joseph's 1914 marriage docket gives him as deceased, born Wales ([R4-S2]). Next door in 1880 lived Evan W. Jones, 60, and Martha, 52, both Welsh, possibly kin.
openQuestions: Children born in England c.1865-1870: a 1871 England census search (Ancestry/FindMyPast) for Edward & Margaret Jones with Ann, Rose and Mary would show where they lived.
